# armor

An armour tier, unlocked by an application (`app`).

A mod adds records in `records/armor/<file>.json` (`{ "$schema": "carina-records/1", "catalog": "armor", "records": [...] }`) and changes base records with patch rows on catalog `armor`. Schema: `schemas/records/armor.schema.json`.

## Fields

A mod record leaves out `id` and `prov`: the game assigns ids, and `prov` is the project's own provenance.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `<namespace>.<snake_case>`: your package id with `-` read as `_`, then a name | yes |  |
| `app` | snake_case key | yes |  |
| `mult` | integer >= 1 | yes |  |
| `troopBonus` | integer >= 0 | yes |  |
| `strategicHp` | integer >= 0 | yes |  |
| `negatesAp` | true or false | yes |  |
| `nameKey` | text key | yes |  |

## Also register it in

Nothing else: the record works on its own.

## Computer players

The ship designer, starting designs and refits take the strongest known armour by its stats: `mult`, then `strategicHp`, then the later record on a full tie. A weaker mod tier is never picked over a stronger one the empire knows.

## Patch paths

Rows on this catalog address a record by `key` and a field by `path`:

- `set`: `app`, `mult`, `nameKey`, `negatesAp`, `strategicHp`, `troopBonus`
- `append`, `insertAfter`, `removeValue`: none (no list fields)
